name: Downstream 3D Object Detection in NeRF
definition: A task to predict 3D Oriented Bounding Boxes (OBBs) by regressing bounding box offsets, objectness scores, and objectness probabilities for each voxel, similar to an anchor-free Region Proposal Network (RPN).
summary: Downstream 3D Object Detection in NeRF predicts 3D oriented bounding boxes using a NeRF-MAE pre-trained encoder, differing from standard methods by avoiding training from scratch.
